name_en: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai (Kalaignar Mahalir Urimai Thittam)
department: Special Programme Implementation Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: Women heads of family get Rs 12,000 a year from the Tamil Nadu government, to help run the home.

other: Meant for women who are the head of their household.

documents: If no Aadhaar yet: Aadhaar enrolment slip plus one ID such as bank or post office passbook with photo, PAN card, passport, ration card, voter ID, MGNREGA card or driving licence
go_number: G.O.Ms. No. 21, Special Programme Implementation, 21 July 2023 (Aadhaar use notification)

evidence.quote: Special Programme Implementation Department is implementing the Kalaignar Mahalir Urimai Thittam
WHICH PROVIDES Rs. 12,000/- PER ANNUM TO IMPROVE THE LIVELIHOOD OF WOMEN
financial assistance to approximately 14,723 women heads of households
provided she is entitled to obtain Aadhaar
providing financial assistance to approximately 14,723 women heads of households
is required to furnish proof of possession of Aadhaar number or undergo Aadhaar authentication
Bank or Post office Passbook with Photo
G.O.Ms. No. 21, Special Programme Implementation, 21st July 2023

gaps: Official KMUT portal kmut.tn.gov.in could not be saved (its SSL certificate has expired), so age (21+), income, land, electricity and exclusion rules are NOT included. Only the 2023 Gazette and an NRT Commissionerate page were saved.
Benefit is stated as Rs 12,000 per year in the July 2023 Gazette; the monthly Rs 1,000 split is not stated in saved sources.
How and where to apply are not in the saved sources (news says ration-shop camps / e-Sevai; not verified).

Status doubt: Tamil Nadu changed government in 2026 and news (not official) mentions a possible rename or restructure; the saved official sources are from 2023-2024. Re-check the current status before showing this.
No helpline found in saved sources.

review.note: Rs 1,000 a month (Rs 12,000 a year) is the latest regular amount the owner could confirm. A one-time Rs 5,000 payment in February 2026 was not a permanent rise, and a proposed rise to Rs 2,000 a month is not confirmed. Our saved source is the 2023 Gazette.
